text:
Ana (Design): quick thought after usability round: compact rules feel visually flat and it's hard to tell which rule matched in the sim. suggest a tiny transient callout + stronger drag affordance. Ben (PM): yep, support tickets keep asking 'why did this go to X'. concrete ask: show rule name + one-line reason during sim. Chris (Frontend): doable. prefer callout be inline DOM sibling of the row so scrolling doesn't jump. CSS idea: `.rule-callout{max-width:320px;border-left:3px solid var(--accent);box-shadow:0 6px 12px rgba(0,0,0,0.06);transition:opacity .2s,transform .2s}` Mina (Eng): backend can add `match_summary` (<=120 chars) in sim response. we'll cap and escape. recommend only auto-show the first match unless user toggles continuous detail. Jo (A11y): a11y checklist: announce via `role="status"` with `aria-atomic="true"` and full-sentence copy: e.g., "Preview: rule 'Block large files' matched because file size exceeded 50 MB." also grab handle needs accessible name and 44x44 touch target. Ana (Design): sample callout text: "Matched: Block large files — file size > 50MB". CTA in callout: "Show details" which opens expanded conditions. Chris (Frontend): for keyboard users, we'll expose a visible "Reorder" label in compact keyboard-only mode and keep an icon otherwise. aria snippet: ```html
Preview: rule 'Block large files' matched because file size exceeded 50 MB.
``` Mina (Eng): perf note: avoid spamming match callouts for high-frequency sim streams. front can debounce to first match and show a persistent indicator if user asks for more. Ben (PM): microcopy tweak: replace global toast "Policy check failed" with inline badge "Conflict with 'Allow - billing'" + CTA "Show conflict details". clearer in screenshots. Jo (A11y): contrast nit: brand blue #2F80ED fails small text. use #004EA8 for accents so callout bar meets 4.5:1. focus outlines must be >=3px and meet 3:1. Chris (Frontend): will prototype CSS + aria changes and open a WIP PR. will throttle accent animation during sim to protect low-end devices. Ana (Design): filing a short issue with copy + a11y asks. can we quick-review tomorrow 9am? deploy-bot: Staging updated with branch `ux/sim-callouts` at 14:07 UTC — https://staging.redwood.ai/routing/sim-preview Ben (PM): scheduled 9am review. thanks everyone!
